'''Task''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] who commanded the [[Imperial Customs Corvette|Imperial Customs corvette]] [[Gatekeeper (Imperial Customs corvette)|''Gatekeeper'']]. He was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the [[Mission to Quellor]], a battle that also caused the destruction of the ''Gatekeeper''.<ref name="CS" />
